p, k = map(int, input().split())
MOD = 1000000007

def power_mod(base, exp):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return res

if k == 1:
    print(power_mod(p, p))
else:
    w = [0] * p
    for i in range(1, p):
        w[i] = (k * i) % p

    visited = [False] * p
    components = 0

    for i in range(1, p):
        if visited[i]:
            continue
        t = i
        while not visited[t]:
            visited[t] = True
            t = w[t]
        components += 1

    print(power_mod(p, components))
